title: Power BI Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(activity="*Failed*" OR result="Failure")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Power BI and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Power BI is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Power BI logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Power BI error rate with anomaly band.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Power BI errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
